title: Book Talk with Michael Mauboussin  - "Expectations Investing"
summary: The talk argues that standard income statements often understate a company's true investment levels because they fail to account for significant intangible investments. By adjusting for these intangibles, investors can recalculate free cash flow and invested capital to get a more accurate picture of a firm's financial reality. The speaker uses Microsoft as a specific case study to illustrate how this adjustment reveals that companies frequently invest more than is perceived at first glance.
